scope.description: Whole whispercpp application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Local speech recognition, language/translation, segmentation/timing, decoding controls, streaming, VAD and model/runtime choices.

coverage.rationale: Offline transcription and cue-length targets cover a central family; translation, language detection, VAD, diarisation and streaming are absent. Host editorial routes improve the chain without increasing native API breadth.

scope.description: Bounded speech transcription to draft timed text, explicit human correction versions and host-only caption line layout.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Draft/review provenance, per-cue correction ledgers and explicit caption-layout goals express connected editorial work; accuracy and review remain human decisions.

limitations: CPU PCM16 mono 16 kHz bounded transcription; accuracy is not certified. Correction/caption routes launch no recogniser and have no native qualification; Unicode code-point layout is not readability certification.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
